about: The tool registry: the only route to using a tool (modules/tool-making/MODULE.md). A tool counts as part of the organization only when its row's adopted_by points to a decision the founder signed; seed tools say adopted_by seed. Rows are never deleted: a retired tool keeps its row with status retired. Never put a key or password here; say only where it is kept.

tools.purpose: Checks the records, their whole history, the witness, signatures and the governance of every structural item.
CK-1 claim by claim: each verified claim's quotation against its saved source, and each passage quoted in org/ against the founder's words and the saved sources. Changes nothing.
The founder's close-out, run in a terminal: checks, asks the founder to sign each decision, commits, and pushes to the witness.
Exports the witnessed history at a revision as an RO-Crate 1.3 (Process Run Crate 0.6 profile) with a W3C PROV file inside, outside the folder; the same revision gives the same bytes.
Drills: the founder plants a sealed fault and later reveals it, to test whether checks still catch what they should.
Exports the organization as a git bundle with its whole history, plus a relocation note, outside the folder.
Creates a new organization from the seed with no AI and no network, records its birth hash, and creates its witness.
Records the founder's launch of an agent app as a role instance, with what it runs on, so that the records it writes can be attributed to it and checked.
Shared helpers for the seed's scripts, including the one function that appends records.
Appends one checked record to a records file; the sanctioned way to write records.
Draws view/org_view.html from the organization's files and view/VIEWS.json. No scripts, no network.
Role roll-call: each role's trigger, when it last ran, and whether it is due or stale.
Compiles the rules of the core and of every adopted module into org/RULES_IN_FORCE.md.
Runs the seed's integrity claims on throwaway copies in a temporary folder and reports what held.
Brings the folder back in line with its witness after another copy closed out or a push was refused, keeping this folder's own work or setting it aside in the witness folder; the founder runs it.
Creates and verifies the witness, the copy of the history kept outside the members' reach; its copy inside the witness checks every push.
Lists every place the seed's name appears, or changes it everywhere at once.

Releases the seed itself for publication: the files of its last commit in a new repository with one commit by a neutral identity at a fixed date, after a scan for identifying strings. Refuses to run in an organization.
